name: Therese Shea
title: Pauly D'Angel
body:
Pauly would always greet me when I would arrive at the Parlour. His warm smile and his loving ways made him such an important part of Foundation Mondays. He was such a nice person and I've been single for so long that I asked him if he might have a vegetarian uncle for me somewhere, I'm significantly older than Pauly so going with uncle status seemed appropriate.
When I found out that he made hummus and sold it at the farmers market in Vermont, I told him that I was the queen of hummus, and if he thinks he can make hummus, he needs to bring it to my house and we will have a hummus face off. He brought hummus over to the house and we sat  hummus and declared that I would be the queen of hummus, and he would be the king of hummus.
Your birth brought your father tremendous happiness. I've never seen him so joyful, being a father was the most important thing to him and he loved you dearly. After your father passed, I donated a painting, which was one of an angel with a sword, I decided to rename it Pauly D'Angel. Your father was always an angel, I trust he's watching over you and your mom and all the rest of your family. We loved him so much. Know that you were Oli, your father was over the moon to have a beautiful son like you. Your beloved father is dearly missed.
One Love Always,
Irese
